author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for The Sin of Fabien, a psychological horror game built around guilt, memory, and a truth the protagonist refuses to face. The Sin of Fabien combines atmospheric pixel art, psychological horror, disturbing environmental storytelling, and surreal moments designed to stay in the player’s mind long after the game ends. Coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Sin of Fabien - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Maximum Pro League 2.0 launch trailer for Maximum Football, a free-to-play American football sports simulation game developed by Modus Games. The MPL update fundamentally transforms how players build, customize, and dominate on the field, shifting the focus from chance-based systems to full player-driven progression. The Maximum Pro League 2.0 is available now in Maximum Football.
title: Maximum Football - Official Maximum Pro League 2.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the gameplay trailer for Booster Pack Heroes, a short incremental game about opening booster packs and surviving monster hordes, developed by zup. Discover rare heroes, upgrade their power, cast powerful spells, and climb through ever harder chapters. Booster Pack Heroes is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Booster Pack Heroes - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Early Access gameplay trailer for Subnautica 2, an aquatic survival adventure exploration game developed by Unknown Worlds Entertainment. Players will plunge to the depths to explore an alien world to build bases, make use of a variety of tools, and uncover long-dormant mysteries with friends. Subnautica 2 is launching into Early Access on May 14 for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Subnautica 2 - Official Early Access Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the accolades trailer for Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched beat ‘em up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band. Check out the critical reception behind Dead as Disco, out now in PC Early Access via Steam and Epic Games Store.
title: Dead As Disco - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Farm to Table is available now in Early Access on Steam. Watch the Farm to Table early access launch trailer for this cozy farming and restaurant management sim. Check out gameplay to see how you can harvest crops, design your restaurant, cook food, and serve your customers in this new Farm to Table trailer. 

Farm to Table is a farming and restaurant management sim with base-building elements. Grow crops in your backyard to cook and serve! Discover new recipes by exploring ingredients on the island; gather, fish, raise animals and produce with machines. Manage resources, hire staff and grow your organic business into a 5-star restaurant!
title: Farm to Table - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the demo launch trailer for HOPE 01, a survival RPG developed by Bending Boys Games. Wake up in a deteriorating underground facility with nothing but a mysterious request to find HAB 01.
Explore a perilous interconnected labyrinth, help survivors, and ultimately dictate the fate of humanity with multiple endings. HOPE 01 is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: HOPE 01 - Official Demo Launch Trailer
